prompt:
Create a 2 minute 30 second instrumental discovery piece about a sheet remembering its creases. Around 74 BPM, Bb major. Piano phrases fold into inner registers, unfold, fold again; harp is a crease pattern; clarinet holds the finished form. Tactile, patient, clever. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no lyrics, no hummed melody-as-voice, no singing, no whispered speech. No snare rolls, no cinematic paper-rip sample as joke.

[00:00–00:22] Open piano voicing, flat like a sheet.
[00:22–01:05] Inner notes tuck; brushes mark creases; phrase becomes denser.
[01:05–01:45] Unfold (more open), then a sharper fold; harp maps the pattern.
[01:45–02:30] Compact finished form on clarinet and piano, still, as if the model sits on a table.
